content: Haidilao’s founders sold 4.65% of shares, triggering a stock price drop. This action is likely driven by a new Chinese tax policy effective July 2026, which imposes 20% personal income tax on offshore trust assets and gains. The rule requires reporting backdated to January 2023, with unpaid taxes due by October 22, 2026. Facing significant cash liabilities estimated at 1.9 billion yuan, Haidilao’s founders liquidated shares to settle these obligations. Similar offshore trust structures used by founders of other listed consumer companies now face identical financial pressures and compliance deadlines, potentially influencing future corporate financing strategies.

title: 我搞数学的朋友，要被llm创飞了 | 原文
content: The author describes a conversation with a mathematician colleague who feels threatened by large language models, expressing doubt about his professional value. This anxiety contrasts with Terence Tao’s recent article, which suggests the field must establish new standards for evaluation. The author feels distressed by this disparity, arguing that while Tao can articulate the need for adaptation with elegance, ordinary mathematicians face immediate, personal impacts. This highlights the broader industry concern that AI may reshape professional landscapes, potentially limiting roles to only the top performers and forcing fundamental changes in how mathematical contribution is defined.

title: ICYMI: What landed for AI builders in August 2026
content: AWS announced major updates to Bedrock, AgentCore, and Strands, enabling developers to build scalable, production-ready AI agents. These updates include million-token context support for OpenAI GPT-5.6 models, global inference routing, and granular cost allocation. Security features now integrate OpenAI’s Daybreak models for defensive and offensive workflows. Additionally, AgentCore supports 14-day runtime sessions, temporal action policies, and managed payments. Strands facilitates multi-robot coordination, while AWS GovCloud now offers advanced models like Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 for regulated environments.
